name: Layout Builder Limit
description: Provides limits to components in layout builder sections and regions.
project_description: Layout Builder Limit lets administrators set a minimum and/or maximum number of components (blocks) allowed in a Layout Builder section, or per region within a section. Enable a minimum to require at least N blocks, or a maximum to cap a section/region at N blocks. The limits are configured directly on the section-configuration form (guarded by two module permissions, one for default displays and one for overrides) and stored as a layout third-party setting. When a maximum is reached the module hides the 'Add block' link and filters out available block plugins, and it validates the whole layout on save so an over-limit or under-limit layout cannot be persisted. When used together with Layout Builder Lock and Layout Builder Restrictions you can control which sections are editable, which block/layout types may be placed, and now how many components a section or region must or may contain.
